items: 【Show Off Your Style & Collectibles】This 5 shelf bookcase with 10 open shelves is more than storage —it’s your personal display zone. Show off your favorite books, LEGO creations, handbags, plants, or treasured collectibles, all in one organized and stylish spot
【Bookcase with Raised Baffle】Each shelf has raised edges so your books don’t slide, your plants stay put, and your décor always looks neat. Perfect for that tricky corner or right behind the couch

【Fits Anywhere in Your Home】Bedroom, office, living room, or even the kitchen—this 5 shelf bookcase adapts to your needs. Use it as a toy rack in the nursery, a file organizer in your office, or a chic coffee station in your nook. One piece, endless possibilities

【Sturdy Enough for Real Life】Built with thickened boards, a metal frame and x-shaped bar, it's tough enough to hold heavy books and durable enough to survive daily use. Adjustable feet keep this bookshelf for bedroom steady even on uneven wood floors or carpet

【Easy to Put Together】Moving into a new place? Redoing your room? Don’t worry—clear instructions, numbered components and labeled parts make setup simple. You can totally handle this display bookshelf with storage
